_note: What scripts/bundle.js puts in an installer beside the app: the browser the booking robots drive, by the Playwright version package.json pins. Targets are electron-builder's ${os}-${arch}.

browser._note: Installed by the Playwright this package pins (package.json), so the browser always matches the library that drives it. Playwright has no per-file digests; its CDN is HTTPS and the revision is fixed by the version.
